messages:
Customer: Hey team — getting reports that streaming responses cut off after an auth refresh. They see a 401 mid-stream then reconnect but the final chunk is missing. Repro attached.
Aisha: thanks for filing, can you paste the minimal repro and server logs?
Customer: repro below. Node app using EventSource polyfill + token rotation. Sometimes the iterator yields an empty string for the last frame.
Customer: ```js
// simplified repro
const es = new EventSource(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
es.onmessage = (e) => console.log('chunk', e.data);
// rotate token every 55s via refresh endpoint
```
Customer: server logs show: 
```
2026-02-15T12:13:22Z DEBUG conn=abc seq=1024 send chunk
2026-02-15T12:13:43Z WARN auth token expired for conn=abc -> 401
2026-02-15T12:13:44Z INFO reconnect from client conn=abc seq_req=1025
2026-02-15T12:13:44Z DEBUG resume window check failed: last_seq_seen=1024, requested=1025 -> allowed
2026-02-15T12:13:44Z DEBUG sent resume frames up to seq=1026 (final), then closed conn
```
Customer: client prints: 
```
chunk "...partial text..."
chunk ""
// then stream end, missing trailing tokens
```
Aisha: ok will triage. @dev-bot create internal ticket? :eyes:
dev-bot: created TICKET-9451 (support/streaming)
Lukas: quick thought — looks like a race when auth fails between sending the last frame and closing the connection. If the runtime marks the conn closed before the client has ACKed final frame, EventSource polyfill may interpret empty message as end.
Mia: SDK lead here — do we have deterministic repro? Is this only with EventSource polyfill or also fetch-based SSE?
Customer: observed on Node EventSource + browser EventSource. Less common on our fetch long-poll code.
Lukas: can you try repro with adjusted timing: delay token rotation by +200ms so the server has time to flush final chunk? If that reduces frequency, it's a flush/timing issue.
Customer: did that — frequency drops to <1% but still happens.
Juan: can you paste headers on the resume request? We want to confirm resume seq semantics.
Customer: resume request: `GET /stream?resume_seq=1025` headers: `Authorization: Bearer <new-token>` and `Accept: text/event-stream`
Lukas: thanks. Two potential bugs: (1) server-side: resume handler might drop the final sentinel event when transitioning auth contexts, (2) client-side: polyfill might emit an empty message for a keepalive suffix — need to ensure empty payloads are skipped.
Mia: immediate mitigation for customers: update client to ignore empty-string events and await explicit `event: done` sentinel. I'll draft a patch:
```js
es.onmessage = (e) => { if (!e.data) return; handleChunk(e.data); }
// also add: es.addEventListener('done', () => finalize())
```
Aisha: good short-term approach. For long-term, we should add server-side guard to send `event: done` before revoking token or closing. Lukas, can runtime emit final_done before rotating creds?
Lukas: yes we can emit a final sentinel. We'll need a small change: when token expiry path is detected, flush KV cache and send `event: done
data: __FINAL__

` before closing. I'll spike.
Mia: SDK action items: (1) skip empty messages in polyfill (patch), (2) expose resume/backoff debug flags, (3) document auth rotation best practices.
Aisha: support: capture affected customer ids and link to TICKET-9451. Any billing implications? customer worried about duplicate token charges on reconnect.
Juan: duplicates should not be billed if resume happens with same seq — but if client replays token and server re-processes same seq, we need idempotency guards. Add to ticket.
Customer: thanks — happy to test patches. Also seeing increased latency around the token rotate window. Anything I can instrument?
Lukas: please add these traces: `stream.recv.seq`, `stream.send.flush_time_ms`, `auth.rotate.start_ts`, `auth.rotate.finish_ts`. That will show ordering.
Customer: will add traces and follow up. Appreciate the quick loop. :heart:
Mia: assigning SDK engineer to TICKET-9451, will push patch to polyfill and cut a patch release today if QA ok.
Aisha: closing loop here for now, will update thread with ticket link and PRs. :white_check_mark:
